notes.title: Now you KNOW you've got a power-up! Version 1.1 available!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/24edw0y.png[/IMG]

[h1]Version 1.1 is out now![/h1]

[b]So... What's New?[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added visual and audio effects when you get a power-up in-game
    [*]Adjusted look of the golden 750-point gem to look less like the electricity enemy
    [*]Adjusted graphical error in the mermaid, now her thumbs are screwed on the right way around
    [*]Three additional languages supported: German, Hungarian and Romanian
    [*]Other minor bug fixes & adjustments
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.0b Available
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.0b Available![/b]

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/11kzcbk.png[/IMG]

A small upgrade is available, upgrade to Version 1.0b now!

[b]What's new?[/b]
- Two additional language support options (Croatian & Portuguese)
- A bug in Version 1.0a in which, if you'd upgraded from 1.0, it would sometimes fail to run the game, has now been repaired
- Minor optimisation fixes and adjustments to help the game run smoother

[i][b]Stay tuned![/b] - More language support coming soon![/i]
